extension.description: Plays free live channels from the Balkans exactly as the broadcasters publish them on their own websites. Channels are sorted by country and genre. No paid channels, no DRM, no geo-unblocking.
extension.news: 0.5.1: Channel lists keep a copy on the TV: lists from a USB stick keep working after it is removed, and web lists still open when their server is down. 0.5.0: Your M3U channel lists in Kodi's TV section (IPTV Manager), with the TV guide named in the list (url-tvg). 0.4.0: My sources detects what an address is: stream, video file, channel list, web page or YouTube. Open an address once without saving. 0.3.0: Better link finding on web pages: video tags, mp4, player settings, embedded players two levels deep, YouTube live embeds. 0.2.0: My sources: add your own web pages and M3U channel lists. 0.1.0: first version with North Macedonia channels to test.
